repo_deltas_executed.purpose: Read-only exact installed package/runtime/changelog provenance discriminator.
Read-only DSC-SHA256-verified inspection of the exact published Ubuntu 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7 Debian patchset.

live_primary_evidence.claim_used: The WAL-reset corruption bug is likely present through 3.51.2, fixed in 3.51.3+, with selected older backports named.
3.51.3 fixes the WAL-reset corruption bug; later 3.53.x lineage includes the fix.
Noble security package 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7 addresses Session-extension CVEs 2026-50812/50813, not a stated WAL-reset repair.

grf_candidates.hypothesis: Ubuntu 3.45.1-1ubuntu2.7 contains the WAL-reset repair despite the upstream version number.
grf_candidates.strongest_counter_reality: The package contains only unrelated Ubuntu security patches and remains on an unfixed WAL lineage.
grf_candidates.discriminating_test: Inspect installed changelog, then exact published DSC-verified Debian patchset for WAL-reset markers or wal.c-touching patches.
grf_candidates.epistemic_limit: No claim of live corruption reproduction or proof over every hypothetical non-published vendor build.

grf_candidates.hypothesis: A root-owned anchor matching version/source-id/library hash is sufficient to establish WAL safety.
grf_candidates.strongest_counter_reality: An anchor can faithfully attest an exact but still unfixed 3.45.1 runtime; identity consistency is not safety provenance.
grf_candidates.replacement_rule: Admission must bind to a known-safe fixed lineage or an independently verified exact backport, not merely to internally consistent bytes.

grf_candidates.hypothesis: A fixed 3.53.4 runtime can execute on the accepted host without replacing the system SQLite package.
grf_candidates.strongest_counter_reality: Loader/runtime constraints prevent Python from actually mapping the expected fixed library.
grf_candidates.evidence: Run 31523517392 mapped the expected 3.53.4 object and source-id on the accepted self-hosted Ubuntu runner without system install.
grf_candidates.promotion_limit: No canonical Frank DB was opened; production trust-anchor/service wiring remains absent.

go_unusual_experiment.baseline: Missing production anchor is rejected by the read-only productive-path matcher.
go_unusual_experiment.intervention: Construct a synthetic anchor containing exactly the already observed 3.45.1 sqlite_version, sqlite_source_id and library_sha256, without claiming fixed-lineage provenance.
go_unusual_experiment.result: The identity-only comparison admits the synthetic anchor with zero mismatches.
go_unusual_experiment.interpretation: Identity attestation and safety provenance are distinct gates. A self-consistent anchor must not be promoted as proof of the WAL repair.
go_unusual_experiment.rollback: No persistent intervention; synthetic object discarded.
go_unusual_experiment.scope: Applies to the tested identity-only matcher semantics; newer deployment guards may add stronger policy and must be evaluated independently.

next_falsifier: With independent trusted deployment/admin authority: install or provision an exact approved fixed 3.53.4 runtime object, create the root-owned/non-writable fixed deployment anchor, run positive V5 admission plus downgrade/library-swap/restart and WAL-recovery controls, then test a disposable copy of the real Frank persistence topology before any canonical state promotion.
